meta.title: 穿裙子怎么拍？亲测实用的拍照姿势
meta.title_en: How to Pose in a Skirt: Tested and Practical
meta.topic: 拍照姿势 · 表情、道具与裙型

scenes.context: 想笑得天真就嘴角用力上抬，想温柔就往外弯，三档假笑。
sentences: 想笑天真一点就用力往上抬。
To smile innocently, lift the corners up.
innocently（天真地）
想笑得温柔就往外弯。
To smile gently, curve the corners outward.
curve outward（往外弯）
微笑是一种礼貌，也是一种警告。
A smile is politeness — and also a warning.
politeness（礼貌）
paraphrase: Three styles of smile: innocent, gentle, and commanding.
scenes.speak: To smile innocently, lift the corners up. To smile gently, curve the corners outward. A smile is politeness — and also a warning.

scenes.context: 帽子调对角度才有牛仔感；墨镜遮住眉毛就显怪异。
sentences: 这样戴才有感觉，有牛仔的感觉。
Worn this way it finally has that cowgirl vibe.
vibe（感觉）
戴墨镜总不好看，可能是眉毛遮住了。
Sunglasses look off when they cover your brows.
cover（遮住）
把眉毛露出来，这样就不会怪了。
Show the brows and it stops looking odd.
odd（奇怪）
paraphrase: Tilt the hat to the right angle.
Let the eyebrows peek out above the frame.
scenes.speak: Worn this way it finally has that cowgirl vibe. Sunglasses look off when they cover your brows. Show the brows and it stops looking odd.

scenes.context: 姿势一挎包提裙配温柔假笑，姿势二穿裙看展侧身；小外套还能挡腰线。
sentences: 第一个姿势就是我最常用的提裙子。
The first pose is lifting the skirt — my favorite.
lift the skirt（提裙子）
穿裙子看展的话，这个脚往前。
For exhibitions, step one foot forward.
step forward（脚往前）
拿个小外套，还可以挡住腰线。
Grab a light jacket — it also hides the waistline.
waistline（腰线）
paraphrase: Sling a bag and gently lift the hem.
Use the jacket to soften the waist area.
scenes.speak: The first pose is lifting the skirt — my favorite. For exhibitions, step one foot forward. Grab a light jacket — it also hides the waistline.

scenes.context: 收腰位置决定比例，收得好就不显五五分；垂感好小个子也友好。
sentences: 收腰位置收得不好容易显五五分。
A poor waist placement makes you look 50-50.
收腰收在这里就特别好。
This waist placement works really well.
waist placement（收腰位置）
长到脚面的裙子走起来很温柔。
A floor-length skirt walks with a soft, gentle vibe.
floor-length（到脚面）
paraphrase: It keeps your proportions from splitting in half.
scenes.speak: A poor waist placement makes you look 50-50. This waist placement works really well. A floor-length skirt walks with a soft, gentle vibe.

practice: 拍照想笑得温柔要怎样？
Curve the mouth corners outward gently.
Because the frame covers your brows — show them.
第一个常用姿势是什么？
Lift the skirt with a soft smile.
The waist placement and how the fabric drapes.
pitfalls: 收腰位置与垂感决定效果。
